transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Doctor. I came in because... well, I just can't seem to shake this feeling that I've failed. I feel like I failed as a father, and really, just as a useful person in general. It's this thought that just keeps looping in my head, over and over, until I start feeling like I really don't deserve much of a future.
How long have you been feeling this way—weeks, months, or longer?
It's been about a month now. It really started right after my daughter left for college out of state.
Have you ever experienced a similar period of low mood, loss of interest, or hopelessness like this before, at any point earlier in your life?

No, I haven't. I mean, I've had bad days before, sure, like anyone else. But nothing like this. This heavy, constant feeling... it's completely new to me. I've never felt this kind of hopelessness before.

Would you say this heavy, hopeless feeling is with you most of the day, nearly every day, even during times when you're not specifically thinking about your daughter being away—like at work or with friends?

Yes, it is. It's there pretty much all the time, every day. It doesn't really matter what I'm doing. Even if I'm trying to distract myself or I'm not actively thinking about her being gone, that heavy feeling just sits there. It doesn't go away.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with friends, over this past month?

Yes, I have. I used to really look forward to working on my model railway, and watching Cubs games with my daughter. But now... the trains just sit there half-built on the table. I haven't touched them in weeks. And even the idea of just putting a baseball game on the TV feels completely pointless. I just don't have any desire to do the things I used to like.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep over the past month—such as trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or waking up much earlier than usual?

Yeah, my sleep has been pretty bad. I just... I lie in bed for hours. The house is just so quiet now, and I can't seem to drift off. And then, even when I do finally fall asleep, I'm wide awake by three or four in the morning. I just lie there, and I can't get back to sleep because my mind just starts racing... running through every little thing I've messed up in my life. It's exhausting.
When you say you feel like you don't deserve much of a future, have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself or wishing you weren't alive?

Yes, I have. I've had these thoughts lately... that maybe it would just be easier if I went to sleep and didn't wake up. It's not that I have a plan to do anything, but... well, the other night I actually caught myself going through my bank statements and life insurance policies, making sure everything was organized. Like I was getting my finances ready for someone else to take over. When I realized what I was doing, it really scared me.

Have you experienced anything like hearing voices, seeing things others don't, or having strong beliefs that others might find unusual—such as feeling you're being punished or that something terrible is about to happen?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I don't hear voices or... or see things that aren't there. And I don't have any strange beliefs about being punished or anything. I mean, I feel terrible about myself, like I said, but I don't think some outside force is coming after me or that something terrible is about to happen. So, no, none of that.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or your weight over this past month?

Yeah, my appetite is pretty much gone. Most days I just don't bother making a real meal. I... I actually forget to eat until it gets late, and even then, I usually only manage to get down some toast or a bowl of cereal. As for my weight, I've definitely lost some. I've had to tighten my belt a notch or two lately just to keep my pants up.
